name: TPU7x (Ironwood) performance optimizations
notes: FP8 training (1.3x over BF16), sharding strategy framework (FSDP/TP/EP/CP), SparseCore collective offloading, activation rematerialization (25-30% overhead), scoped VMEM tuning (64 MiB per TensorCore), Tokamax kernels (Splash attention, Megablox GMM).
